title: Software
rebootPending: The system was updated and needs a restart to use the new kernel or core libraries.

error.load: Could not load the software list

hero.aurOnly: AUR packages are updated from the terminal for now.
hero.upToDateText: Your system and apps are on the latest versions.

schedule.title: Update automatically
schedule.text: The server installs all updates every day at this time, like Update all. It uses a systemd timer called linuxadmin-update.timer.
schedule.hint: Server time, 24-hour clock. If the machine is off at that time, the update runs when it starts.

aur.warning: AUR packages are built from community scripts. Review the PKGBUILD before updating. They are left unselected.
aur.terminal: For now, update them from a terminal (for example: {helper} -Sua).

partial.title: Update everything instead?
partial.text: Arch Linux does not support partial upgrades: updating only some packages can leave the system unable to start programs.
partial.hint: Arch does not support partial upgrades. Unless you know why, use Update all.

store.noneText: Try another word, or a shorter one.
store.installedText_one: 1 installed by you, the rest are dependencies. Apps above are the ones with a desktop entry.
store.installedText_other: {count} installed by you, the rest are dependencies. Apps above are the ones with a desktop entry.

install.title: Install {name}?
install.text: This adds the software to the whole system and runs as administrator.
install.admin: Administrator (you may be asked for your password)
install.deps: Packages it depends on are installed too.

remove.title: Remove {name}?
remove.text: The software is uninstalled and dependencies nothing else needs are removed. Your own files stay.

installed.noneText: Change the filter or the search text.

history.noneText: Installs, updates and removals show up here.

tx.busy: Another software change is already running.
tx.lost: The connection was lost. The change may still be running on the server.
tx.rebootLater: A kernel or core library is being updated. Restart when this finishes to use it.
tx.rebootNow: Restart the computer to finish: the new kernel or core libraries are only used after a reboot.

hint.locked: Another package manager is running. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
hint.outdated: The package lists are out of date. Update the whole system first, then try again.
hint.conflict: Files of this package clash with files already on the system. Check the output above.
hint.signature: A package signature could not be verified. The keyring may need refreshing.
hint.network: The package servers could not be reached. Check the network connection.
